messages:
Sana: Heads-up 1: we need a concise SEO handoff for the webinar landing (launch in 36h). Focus: keyword targets, anchor text recommendations, canonical strategy, redirects, and schema. Who can own?
Greg: I can take keywords + anchors. Nora can verify canonical + redirects with infra.
Nora: Yep - can do redirects and canonical. Quick ask: any legacy event pages to retire?
Sana: Two old microsites: /events/jan2025 and /campaigns/edge-ai. Want them consolidated to /webinars/serving-llms-prod.
jamie: I'll prepare the social UTMs and share mapping with sales routing.
Greg: KW targets (pick 2 primary + 4 supporting):
- Primary: "LLM serving best practices", "scalable LLM inference"
- Supporting: "inference latency optimization", "batching strategies for LLMs", "LLM deployment patterns", "production LLM routing"
Greg: Recommended H1/hero: "Scalable, Low-Latency LLM Serving"
Greg: Longtails for FAQ (examples): "how to reduce LLM inference cost", "LLM caching strategies for real-time apps"
Nora: Redirect plan (nginx snippet):
```
# Redirect legacy event pages to canonical webinar landing
location = /events/jan2025 {
  return 301 /webinars/serving-llms-prod;
}
location ^~ /campaigns/edge-ai/ {
  rewrite ^/campaigns/edge-ai/(.*)$ /webinars/serving-llms-prod permanent;
}
```
Nora: Canonical guidance: webinar landing -> self canonical. Any archived promos should be 301 -> landing and set meta robots to follow/index only on the landing. No meta-refresh redirects.
Sana: Internal linking matrix (preferred flow): Blog (use case post) -> Benchmarks page -> Webinar landing -> Docs integration guide. Anchor suggestions: Blog -> "real-world latency wins", Benchmarks -> "performance benchmarks", Docs -> "integration guide".
jamie: UTM scheme for channels: utm_source=marcom, utm_medium=email|social|partner, utm_campaign=webinar_servingllms_jun26. Sales routing: jamie to map utm_campaign into CRM field "marketing_campaign" and set lead owner rule: webinar leads -> SDR-Webinar queue.
DevOpsBot: site-scan: found 5 pages with missing Event schema and 3 pages with duplicate titles. Recommend adding JSON-LD event and deduping titles.
Greg: JSON-LD event example to include in <head> (paste as string in CMS):
```
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference Webinar: Serving LLMs in Production","startDate":"2026-06-26T18:00:00Z","eventStatus":"https://schema.org/EventScheduled","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinars/serving-llms-prod"},"organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}
```
Sana: Quick checklist before launch:
- Greg: upload final hero copy + KWs to CMS.
- Nora: push redirect rules + confirm canonical headers.
- jamie: share UTM table and confirm CRM mapping.
- Sana: confirm OG image + title (assets v3).
Nora: I'll open infra PR for the redirect rules and ping infra-oncall for a quick deploy slot.
jamie: Sharing UTM doc in #marketing shortly.
Sana: Great. Can everyone update their task status by EOD? :thumbsup:
Greg: Will do.
Nora: PR by 14:00 PT.
jamie: UTM mapping done and sent to Growth. :white_check_mark:
